green_summary.OutlineInfra.v1: tools/infra/outline.mjs validate|qualify|up|probe|stop. Exit contract 0=PASS 1=input/prerequisite 2=verification failure, matching I01 (registry+refs loads fail-closed, displayPath/redactHostPaths on every structured field, host paths never echoed). validate checks all six domain files: lock component coverage/floating tag/digest format/auth-flag consistency/upGate closed, env binding rules, OIDC registration structure + loopback redirects, storage-policy invariants, owner/audience/grant registration, cross-project refs, JSON safety scan, compose declaration gate; committed files exit 0. qualify evaluates 10 evidence categories on the VERIFIED/RECORDED/UNVERIFIED ladder and exits 2 NOT_READY with per-category reasons; receipt binds sha256 of registry + all six domain files. up refuses with UP_REFUSED_IMAGES_LOCK_NOT_READY (4 unauthenticated components), would refuse UP_NOT_AUTHORIZED on a closed gate even when ready, and reports the observed docker daemon state; no path to a fake launch. stop is honestly UNVERIFIED: this tool never started a stack. Probe subcommands are real: without an instance they exit 2 structured UNVERIFIED; with --endpoint they genuinely attempt GET /api/config and report the raw failure (sandbox EPERM observed), never mock, never skip.
green_summary.OutlineDomain.v1: infra/delivery/outline/collection-registration.example.json: instance (id/url/immutableId null, UNVERIFIED) + two collections (managed-source-collection, isolation-collection), each with registered owner structure (principal null, grantRef -> secret-ref:sdd-harness-pilot/outline-publisher|outline-isolator, UNREGISTERED) and audience structure (readers [], effectiveReaderSet null, UNVERIFIED with closure requirements recorded). Publisher/isolator grants are declared as requiring separate issuance by authorized principals; this task does not self-sign. Validator rejects missing owner/audience/grant and cross-project grants.
green_summary.OutlineState.v1: infra/delivery/outline/storage-policy.json: state.database (postgres, durable=true, secret-ref outline-db), state.attachments (durable=true, secret-ref outline-object-store), state.cache (redis, durable=false, rightsAuthority=false, secret-ref outline-redis; validator forbids either flag flipping). revocation.immediateEffectAssumed=false with signed-URL residue risk recorded. apiContracts record the official-spec observations (fixedCreateUuid declaredBySpec=true; lastRevision declaredBySpec=true, conflictStatusDeclared=409) with status UNVERIFIED — they become VERIFIED only against a real deployment; update conflicts must 409 without blind overwrite.
